ACT III OF 1994
ACT III OF 1994
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th May,
1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Customs (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 98, Act IV of 1969

ACT III OF 1994
ACT III OF 1994
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th May,
1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 98, Act IV of 1969.--In the Customs Act,
1969 (IV of 1969), in section 98, for subsection (1) the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"(1)
Warehoused goods, other than consumer goods as notified by the Central Board of
Revenue, may remain in the warehouse for a period of three months following the
date of their admission into the warehouse and consumer goods so notified may
remain in the warehouse for a period of one month following the said date:
Provided that
the said period may, in case of non-perishable goods, be extended by the Board
or by such officer as authorized by the Board in this behalf, on sufficient
cause being shown by the owner. of the warehoused goods and subject to the
condition that he pays in advance surcharge on the duty and taxes involved at
two percent. per month for the extended period.".
